# 行舟 · 个人项目与事务中心 v0.4.0

这一版本重新明确了“什么时候开始”“现在是否在推进”以及“收件箱究竟代表什么”。计划开始日与工作项层级现在可以减少重复的状态维护，同时所有明确的暂停、阻塞和结束决定仍由用户掌控。

## 主要更新

- 将界面中的“计划日期”明确为“计划开始日”，移除容易与“进行中”重叠的“已计划”状态。
- 未来开始的事项显示弱提示“已安排”；到达计划开始日时，“待开始”事项自动进入“进行中”。旧“已计划”值会按日期兼容转换。
- 支持多日执行区间：计划开始日表示开始，截止日期表示真实期限；已经过去的开始日不再被整理页误判为遗留日期。
- 新增层级状态向上推进：任意后代处于“进行中”时，仍在“收件箱／待开始”的项目祖先会进入“进行中”。
- 长期领域以及明确的阻塞、暂停、将来和结束状态不会被自动覆盖；下级停止后，上级也不会自动倒退。
- “收件箱”现在只表示尚未整理，不再作为项目、事务或想法的正式状态选项。上下文新增和完成分类的条目默认进入“待开始”。
- “全部”默认隐藏已经结束的条目，并新增可记忆本机选择的“包含已结束”开关；必要的已结束上层仍会作为未结束后代的层级路径保留。

## 修复与兼容性

- 修复当前周日期列中的事项仍重复出现在左侧“进行窗口”的问题。
- 修复狭窄侧栏中“已完成”等状态被挤成竖排文字的问题。
- 不需要迁移或重建数据库；思源属性视图仍是唯一数据源。
- 插件会在刷新、跨日或相关编辑后写回符合上述规则的状态，但不会覆盖明确的暂停、阻塞、将来或结束决定。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.4.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Projects & Tasks v0.4.0

This release clarifies when work is scheduled to start, when it is actually in progress, and what Inbox means. Planned start dates and hierarchy rollups now reduce repetitive status maintenance while explicit paused, blocked, and closed decisions remain under user control.

## Highlights

- Renamed the planning field in the UI to Planned Start Date and removed the overlapping Planned lifecycle status.
- Future starts show a subtle Scheduled hint. Ready items automatically become In Progress when their start date arrives, while legacy Planned values are normalized according to date.
- Supports multi-day execution windows: planned start marks the beginning and deadline remains the real due date. Past starts are no longer treated as stale during Review.
- Added upward hierarchy progression: any In Progress descendant promotes project ancestors still in Inbox/Ready to In Progress.
- Areas and explicit blocked, paused, someday, or closed states are never overwritten, and ancestors do not auto-demote when descendants stop.
- Inbox is now a triage-only stage rather than a formal project, transaction, or idea status. Contextually created and classified items start as Ready.
- All hides closed items by default and adds a persisted Include Closed toggle. Closed ancestors required as context for open descendants remain visible.

## Fixes and compatibility

- Prevented items already scheduled in the visible week from appearing again in the left-side Active Window.
- Prevented narrow sidebar cards from stacking statuses such as Completed vertically.
- No database migration or rebuild is required; the native SiYuan Attribute View remains the only data source.
- Xingzhou writes back statuses that follow these rules on refresh, day rollover, or related edits, but never overrides explicit paused, blocked, someday, or closed decisions.

## Download

Download the attached `package.zip`. Do not use GitHub's automatically generated source-code archives as the SiYuan plugin package.

See [CHANGELOG.en.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.4.0/CHANGELOG.en.md) for the complete record.
